scope: saved evidence; no timing, compiler, or native workload reruns
statistical_method: Exact Fraction interpolation on integer nanoseconds at p*(n-1), inclusive Q1/median/Q3; ratios of per-engine medians. IQR overlap is descriptive, not a significance test.
source_control_note: All six application files are unchanged from sequence baseline, so no source-migration control is applicable.

final_tool_provenance.compiler_provenance_scope: Final parent-reported workspace build on the clean committed source; every compiled Rust/Cargo input rechecked against HEAD before and after freeze. No pre-build capture is claimed here.
final_tool_provenance.build_environment_scope: Explicit wrapper settings and parent-reported ordinary command; observed ambient flags at freeze are recorded separately, not claimed as a historical environment capture.
